title: tanager-cryo: a calibrated cryosphere retrieval for Planet Tanager-1
description:
A physics-based retrieval that inverts Planet Tanager-1 surface reflectance into sub-pixel fractions of solid ice/snow, melt pond and dark surface, together with effective absorption length (grain size), melt pond depth and light-absorbing particle load — with a calibrated per-pixel uncertainty on every quantity.

Demonstrated on Arctic sea ice in melt (Sirmilik National Park, Nunavut, 2025-06-06) and validated against same-day Sentinel-2C imagery acquired 29 minutes apart. Includes a controlled band-degradation experiment against Sentinel-2, EMIT and PRISMA, an audit of EMIT coverage over the 2026-08-26 Langtang rock-ice failure via NASA CMR, and a full-catalogue audit showing that none of the 153 scenes in the Tanager Open STAC catalogue intersects a mapped glacier.

Submission to the Planet Tanager Open Data Competition 2026.
notes: Tanager imagery: Tanager STAC Data, available at www.planet.com/data/stac, (c) 2025 Planet Labs PBC, used under CC-BY 4.0.
